title: Awry
summary: AWRY', adjective or adverb 1. Turned or twisted towards one side; not in a straight or true direction, or position; asquint; with oblique vision; as, 'to glance a look awry; ' the lady's cap is awry 2

inlines.v: AWRY', adjective or adverb 1. Turned or twisted towards one side; not in a straight or true direction, or position; asquint; with oblique vision; as, 'to glance a look awry; ' the lady's cap is awry 2. In a figurative sense, turned aside from the line of truth, or right reason; perverse or perversely.
